paragraphs: Zevidah daughter of Pedayah ([II Kings 23:36](https://www.sefaria.org/II_Kings.23.36); Hyman cites 23:33). Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevida, [Berakhot 63b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.63b.24). Rabbi Yose bar Zevida, [Berakhot 13a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.13a.13).[^3]

notes.text: The source cites II Kings 23:33, but the consulted verse naming Zevidah daughter of Pedayah is 23:36. The Biblical and rabbinic attestations are not identified with one another.

Both Hyman’s print (vol. I, p. 381) and the supplied text cite II Kings 23:33. The verse naming Jehoiakim’s mother, Zevidah daughter of Pedayah, is 23:36, where the written form is זבידה and the reading is זבודה. The consulted Berakhot 63b calls its speaker Rav Yehudah bar Zevida. Berakhot 13a gives Rabbi Yose bar Zevida as an alternative attribution to Rabbi Yose bar Avin.

The [Seder HaDorot entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1952&lang=en) separately lists Yose bar Zevida and Yose bar Avin. The cited [Berakhot 13a passage](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.13a.13) gives their names as alternative attributions of the same objection.
